On 10 August 2026, Appellant moved to withdraw his case from appellate
review and attach his DD Form 2330, Waiver/Withdrawal of Appellate Rights
in General and Special Courts-Martial Subject to Review by a Court of Crimi-
nal Appeals, signed by Appellant and Appellant’s counsel on 6 August 2026.
Accordingly, it is by the court on this 13th day of August, 2026,
ORDERED:
Appellant’s Motion to Withdraw from Appellate Review and Attach is
GRANTED. Appellant’s case is forwarded to the Appellate Records Branch
(JAJM) for further processing in accordance with Rules for Courts-Martial
1115(f)(3) and 1201, Manual for Courts-Martial, United States (2024 ed.).
FOR THE COURT
AGNIESZKA M. GAERTNER, Capt, USAF
Commissioner
